name: Maternity Benefit (CBOCWWB)
benefit: - Financial assistance of ₹5100/- shall be given to the spouse of the registered beneficiary woman employee after the delivery of the child.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary should be working in the Establishment, registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965, and her contribution towards the labour welfare fund should regularly been received by the Board.
   1. Financial assistance shall be given to the spouse of the registered beneficiary woman employee after the delivery of the child.
   1. The financial assistance will be given on the production of the birth certificate issued by the competent authority.
   1. The applicant should apply for maternity benefits within three months from the date of delivery.
   1. The beneficiary should have been a registered member of the Board for at least six months prior to the birth of the child.
   1. The benefit under this scheme shall be given for the birth of two children only.
   1. The financial assistance for maternity benefits shall not be given to those beneficiaries who are covered under ESIC.
